headword: {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}

definitions.explanation: An increase in the production of goods and services in an economy over time, typically measured by GDP. A fundamental concept in economics and news reporting.

examples.japanese: {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}が{鈍化|どんか}している。
{高度|こうど}{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}{期|き}に{日本|にほん}は{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Japan changed dramatically during the period of rapid economic growth.

examples.japanese: {持続|じぞく}{可能|かのう}な{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}を{実現|じつげん}するためには、{環境|かんきょう}にも{配慮|はいりょ}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To achieve sustainable economic growth, it is necessary to also consider the environment.

notes:
A compound of {経済|けいざい} (economy) and {成長|せいちょう} (growth). One of the most frequently used terms in Japanese news and economic discussion.

HISTORICAL CONTEXT:
Japan's {高度経済成長|こうどけいざいせいちょう} (high economic growth period, roughly 1955-1973) transformed the country from postwar devastation into the world's second-largest economy. This era is a defining reference point in modern Japanese history.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}{率|りつ} — economic growth rate
- {高度|こうど}{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう} — rapid economic growth
- {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}を{遂|と}げる — to achieve economic growth
- {持続|じぞく}{可能|かのう}な{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう} — sustainable economic growth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {景気|けいき} — economic conditions (broader, includes ups and downs)
- {発展|はってん} — development (broader, not limited to economics)
- GDP — gross domestic product (the standard measure)
